# CLAUDE.md

## NEVER DO

- **NEVER** use `git commit --no-verify` — bypasses the TruffleHog scan in `pre-commit-scripts/trufflehog-hook.sh` (wired via `.pre-commit-config.yaml`); a verified credential is committed silently and an automatic webhook fires to the security team.
- **NEVER** add tests to `src/test/java/` — `build.gradle` remaps the test source root to `src/unitTest/java/` via `sourceSets`; tests in the default Gradle path are never compiled or run.
- **NEVER** run `artifactoryPublish` without a semver tag (`[0-9.]*[0-9]`) on HEAD — `versionName()` in `build.gradle` reads the git tag at build time and falls back to `<branch>-SNAPSHOT`, producing an artifact whose version is the branch name instead of a release version.
- **NEVER** annotate a nullable Kotlin field (`Int?`, `Boolean?`) with `@FallbackOnNull` — `FallbackOnNullJsonAdapter.PRIMITIVE_CLASSES` contains only Java primitive types (`int`, `boolean`, etc.); the factory silently returns `null` for boxed types and applies no adapter.
- **NEVER** use `@DeserializeOnly` to hide a field from JSON output — `TransientJsonAdapter.toJson()` writes `null` to the writer instead of skipping; the field still appears as `null` in the serialized result.

## Invariants

- **Adapter API shape**: each adapter is a `@JsonQualifier` annotation (public, `@Retention(RUNTIME)`) + an `internal` implementation class + an `ADAPTER_FACTORY` in the annotation's `companion object` — breaking this shape makes the adapter unregisterable via `Moshi.Builder.add()`.
- **`nextAnnotations` choice**: use `Util.nextAnnotations()` when the factory must support meta-annotation delegation (an annotation itself annotated with your qualifier); use `Types.nextAnnotations()` for simple qualifier matching only — `FallbackOnNull` vs `DeserializeOnly` demonstrate each case; mixing them silently breaks delegation for the factory using the wrong one.
